assertions.title: Tab navigation preserves restaurant context

steps.expected: Email Delivery route loads with restaurant context and tab UI
steps.observed: Route resolved to /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c with Delivery Log tab visible.

steps.action: Switch from Delivery Log to Queue
steps.expected: Queue tab opens, restaurant context remains selected, and no full page reload occurs
steps.observed: Queue tab opened and URL kept restaurantId, but the browser recorded a fetch to /email-delivery?...&tab=queue&_rsc=... indicating a route-level server component refresh rather than pure client-side tab content swap.

steps.action: Switch from Queue to Analytics and back to Delivery Log
steps.expected: Restaurant context remains stable across tabs with no full page reload behavior
steps.observed: restaurantId remained stable across tab changes, but Analytics triggered repeated GET requests to /email-delivery?...&tab=analytics&_rsc=..., so the no-full-page-reload expectation was not met.

evidence.network: GET /api/ops/email-queue?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&page=1&pageSize=25 on Queue tab; repeated GET /email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&tab=analytics&_rsc=l0zkx on Analytics tab

assertions.issues: Restaurant context was preserved, but tab changes triggered route-level _rsc fetches, so the flow did not satisfy the contract's no full-page reload behavior.

steps.expected: Queue tab opens from the URL
steps.observed: Route resolved to /email-delivery?tab=queue&restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c and Queue tab content was displayed.

steps.expected: Analytics tab opens from the URL
steps.observed: Route resolved to /email-delivery?tab=analytics&restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c and Analytics tab was selected.

evidence.network: Direct URL navigation resolved correctly for queue and analytics tabs

frictions.description: The authenticated route is mounted at /email-delivery; opening /app/email-delivery redirects there while preserving query params and restaurantId.
frictions.resolution: Validated assertions against the resolved authenticated route URLs after redirect.

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 1 passed, 1 failed. Deep-linking to queue/analytics works, but tab switching preserved restaurant context while still issuing route-level _rsc fetches, so the no-full-page-reload requirement failed.
